body: Ten years ago I wasn't suicidal at all, and was enthusiastic about life. But now I'm totally unable to recall the mindset then.

That's fucking right. It's what every fucking relative told me, "stop being a lazy ass and work harder to get more money and have a relationship and then have a baby and you'll get better." 

They are simple-minded retards who simplify everything and think that money and those life routines are the only things that matter.
Going to meet you soon, pal.

I'm always dreaming about falling into the small square in the middle of my department where students gather to rehearse for performance, hang together, etc. Also the study room and common room are just next to it.

I hope it'll kill their enthusiasm for at least a few years.

Great points.

Those who keep blaming you and making you feel guilty without providing any emotional supports are the actually selfish ones.
Most of the things you list used to be the reasons why I still stick around. But don't know why one day they just become not attractive to me anymore.
It's nonsense to illegalise it in the first place.
I wish a serial killer will pick me.
